answer: Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond that decays unless renewed by attested work, and the protocol caps influence at the median bond so cheap identities cannot dominate. An attacker must fund thousands of bonds simultaneously, and slashing burns them on proven duplication. Think of the bond as an anchor in a meadow of ephemeral accounts, with reputation reaching its zenith only through sustained, verified contribution rather than raw count.
